gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-105.221648 35.597175)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] > 1600 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

WITH start_point AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-105.221648, 35.597175), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
raster_analysis AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Distance(start_point.geom, rast) AS distance_meters
  FROM
    start_point,
    public.dem_us
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(
      ST_Envelope(start_point.geom),
      ST_Transform(rast, 4326)
    )
    AND ST_Value(rast, ST_Transform(start_point.geom, ST_SRID(rast))) < 1600
    AND ST_Value(rast, ST_Transform(start_point.geom, ST_SRID(rast)), 1) IS NOT NULL
    AND ST_Value(rast, ST_Transform(start_point.geom, ST_SRID(rast))) IS NOT NULL
    AND ST_Value(rast, ST_Transform(start_point.geom, ST_SRID(rast))) > 1600
)
SELECT
  MIN(distance_meters) AS distance_to_higher_terrain_meters
FROM
  raster_analysis;
